todos: [P2] FULLTASK-RELIABILITY-01: FULLTASK-BEHAVIORAL-CLOSURE-01 is closed (2026-09-24): scripts/live/fullTaskRun.live.ts with qwen2.5-coder:7b reached completionStatus 'verified' in runs 15, 17 and 22 (8/8 in 28 and 34 steps, build first, then npm test). The closure is not yet reliable: of runs 17-26 after the fixes, 2 closed verified. Remaining failure classes, each seen once: run 24 the model called ask about dependency versions and AUTO mode ended the run (the application could answer it: use the published versions); run 26 Vitest 0.26 (pinned by the model) prints 'expected '<div…' to include ...' with a truncated received value and no Expected/Received lines, so the assertion rewrite has no rendered text to use; run 25 a CssSyntaxError under [plugin vite:css] (now diagnosed, not yet rerun); run 21 the model kept @import 'tailwindcss/tailwind.min.css' against the removal directive while the auto-matched tailwind-css-v4 skill told it Tailwind v4 syntax for a project declaring tailwindcss ^3 (see SKILL-VERSION-MISMATCH-01). Next, answer version questions in AUTO from registry facts instead of ending the run, parse the Vitest 0.x assertion format, then rerun until at least 3 of 5 runs close verified.

[P2] GPTOSS-FULLTASK-01: GPTOSS-PLAN-JSON-01 is fixed (2026-09-24): with think:false and a JSON schema gpt-oss:20b returned empty content (827 output tokens, done_reason=stop, logged by describeInvalidStructuredResponse), so structured requests of level-only models now send think 'low' (resolveStructuredThinkValue); plan generation succeeds and the agent loop runs. The full task with ONLYRAG_LIVE_MODEL=gpt-oss:20b then ran 42/50 steps (1-4 minutes per turn, about 55 minutes) and stopped on no_mutation with 0/10 verified: after npm install and the first files it spent steps 16-41 reading files through run_command (sed -n '1,200p', cat, shasum) instead of read_file, and its one npm run build failed. Next, treat shell reads (sed/cat/type/Get-Content on a workspace file) as read_file for loop and no-mutation accounting or redirect them to read_file, act on the failed build's directive, and rerun with gpt-oss:20b.

[P3] SKILL-VERSION-MISMATCH-01: skill auto-discovery (skillAppService, 'Auto-discovered high confidence hub skill') matches on the task text only: live full task run 21 of 2026-09-24 injected tailwind-css-v4 ('use @import "tailwindcss"', no @tailwind directives) into a workspace whose package.json declares tailwindcss ^3, and the model mixed both syntaxes while a directive ordered the broken @import removed. Next, pass the declared dependency versions to skill matching and drop a skill whose declared major version contradicts the manifest.

[P3] EXPLICIT-ANY-BACKLOG-01: since 2026-09-24 noExplicitAny is an error in every non-test file (biome.json override over electron/, shared/, src/ and scripts/; untrusted JSON boundaries use the documented UntrustedJson alias in shared/types, sessionHistoryDomain normalizers use unknown plus narrowing). npx biome lint still lists 134 warnings, all in test doubles: 118 in electron/ (agentOrchestratorToolGates.test.ts 15, toolSchemaValidator.test.ts 14, processToolService.test.ts 12, sidecarAppService.test.ts 9, agentIpc.test.ts 7 lead) and 16 in src/ (soundEffectsService.test.ts 8, i18n.test.ts 3). Next, replace the `as any` casts with typed doubles (`as unknown as T` or builder helpers) module by module, then drop the test exclusion from the override.

[P3] I18N-MAIN-MESSAGES-01: the untitled sentinels are gone (2026-09-24): coding sessions and chat conversations store '' and the renderer shows the localized default, legacy 'Nuova Sessione'/'New Session'/'Nuova Conversazione'/'New Chat' titles read as untitled. Text produced in Main still reaches the UI in Italian only: about 70 agent timeline emitLog messages and the closure summaries (agentOrchestratorApplicationClosure.ts 'Esito applicativo', 'NON VERIFICABILE'/'BLOCCATO', agentOrchestratorToolResultProcessor.ts, agentOrchestratorCircuitBreakerAndVerification.ts), Main error strings such as sidecarAppService.ts 'ID documento non valido.' and sidecarHttpClient.ts 'Eliminazione scaduta...'; the Sidecar chunk prefix '[Documento: … | Sezione: …]' is embedded in stored vectors. Next, give AgentLogEntry an optional message code plus params that the renderer translates (the Italian text stays as fallback and for the model), migrate the closure summary first, and leave the chunk prefix until a re-index migration exists.

[P3] LIVE-AUDIT-REDACTION-01: the coding agent audit log (sanitizeLogMessage in electron/logRedactor.ts, EXCEPTION_DETAIL_PATTERN) replaces the rest of every line containing error/failed/unable followed by ':' with '[details redacted]', which in live snapshots hides the runner messages (ReferenceError text, Vitest/Vite error lines) and even the label 'Last useful error:' itself; the analysis of full task runs 12-26 had to infer causes from code frames. Next, let the live harness (scripts/live/agentLiveHarness.ts) keep an unredacted copy of tool outputs inside %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live for local runs only, leaving the persisted app logs redacted.
